entities.name: Replayed NAS message container
entities.description: Information element included by the UE when HASHMME value in SECURITY MODE COMMAND differs from locally calculated hash value during attach or tracking area updating procedure.

entities.name: Attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure for UE to attach to the network.

entities.name: Tracking area updating procedure
entities.description: Procedure for UE to update its tracking area information.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE COMMAND
entities.description: NAS security mode command message sent by MME to UE.

entities.name: HASHMME
entities.description: Hash value included in SECURITY MODE COMMAND message for security verification.

entities.name: HASHMME mismatch condition
entities.description: Condition where HASHMME value in SECURITY MODE COMMAND differs from locally calculated hash value at UE.

relations.description: SECURITY MODE COMMAND message contains HASHMME information element.
HASHMME mismatch condition triggers inclusion of Replayed NAS message container IE.
Attach procedure context enables HASHMME mismatch condition.
Tracking area updating procedure context enables HASHMME mismatch condition.
